phase: W2.R1 Dynamic Player Value & Game-Plan Intelligence Foundation
declared_before: any model fit, ablation, feature-selection or scoring on any W2.R1 split; at commit time the only W2.R1 artifacts are the environment baseline, the architecture inventory and the data-availability audit (scripts/w2r1/results/data_audit.json, which counts rows and lists columns only)

status_rules.SHADOW_ONLY: Every W2.R1 output is SHADOW / RESEARCH. No W2.R1 number may enter a production recommendation, waiver, lineup, trade or drop path in this phase. Promotion is out of scope and requires a later, separately authorized phase.
status_rules.meaning: SHADOW_QUALIFIED = passes every gate below on FINAL for that position+layer+scoring regime and is eligible to be proposed for promotion in a LATER phase. It changes nothing in production now.

sources.play_by_play: nflreadr::load_pbp, 2022-2026 (wp, spread/total, epa, xpass, pass_oe, sack/int/fumble/penalty, field-goal result/distance, drive)
sources.ftn_charting: nflreadr::load_ftn_charting, 2022-2026 (motion, play action, screen, RPO, blitzers, pass rushers, box, no-huddle, out-of-pocket)
sources.participation: nflreadr::load_participation, 2020-2025 ONLY (formation, personnel, box, coverage, man/zone, routes). NOT published for 2026 (audit: 0 rows).
sources.schedules: nflreadr::load_schedules (lines, total, roof, surface, temp, wind, rest, QB, coach), 2022-2026
sources.injuries: nflreadr::load_injuries (FINAL team-week designation; no publication timestamp: evidence quality RECONSTRUCTED_FINAL_DESIGNATION, symmetric for champion and challenger)
sources.existing_repo_substrates: lib/role-calibration/data, lib/game-distribution/data (2025), lib/player-scheme-intelligence/data, lib/football-intel/data — treated as pre-built point-in-time substrates and re-audited, never trusted blindly

data.tier_A_features: derived from play_by_play + ftn_charting + schedules + player stats: identical definition in EVERY season 2022-2026. These alone may be used for any season including the 2026 FINAL and prospective weeks.
data.tier_B_features: derived from participation (formation, personnel, box, man/zone, coverage shell, routes): available 2022-2025 only. For 2026 targets they may enter ONLY as prior-season carryover evidence discounted by organizational continuity (see continuity). A model fitted with tier-B features must be re-evaluated with the tier-B-carryover-only mask before any 2026 claim; a 2026 claim may not rely on same-season tier-B evidence (it does not exist).
unavailable_documented: point-in-time historical fantasy rosters, waiver pools and FAAB balances for the registered leagues (none stored in the repo)
historical stored Sleeper/RotoWire source projections (proxy baseline used, as in W2.P1)
data.point_in_time_rule: every feature for target game g (team T, kickoff k) may use only games with kickoff strictly < k, schedule/line/weather information published before k, and injury designations flagged as reconstructed. Pre-registered leakage defenses: structural as-of assertion on every row, poison test (target game and later weeks replaced by absurd values must leave features byte-identical), and an ORACLE control (target-game actual tactical outcome as features must beat every candidate by a wide margin, proving the harness is sensitive).

FIT.use: fit coefficients / priors; explore freely (labelled exploratory)

VAL.use: choose among the DECLARED grids only; may be inspected repeatedly. Note: 2025 weeks 14-17 were the FINAL split of W2.P1 for the Role question; they are therefore treated as VAL-contaminated for any Role-adjacent comparison and are never used as FINAL here.

FINAL.seasons_weeks: 2026 weeks 1-5 (completed games only; 79 games at declaration time)
FINAL.use: evaluated exactly once per frozen candidate after FROZEN.json is written; never used to choose anything. Weeks 1-2 rows use prior-season evidence only and are reported separately.

PROSPECTIVE.seasons_weeks: 2026 week >= 6, frozen before kickoff through the W2.P2 capture extension
PROSPECTIVE.use: second, fully prospective confirmation; not used for any gate in this phase

splits.EXCLUDED: 2022-2024 weeks 1-2 as targets (no as-of profile), playoffs, any row whose as-of assertion fails

scoring.PRIMARY: HALF (0.5 PPR, 4pt pass TD, -2 INT, -2 fumble lost, 2pt=2) — identical to W2.P1
scoring.league_fingerprints: Every output carries the league scoring fingerprint. A model qualified under a scoring regime is qualified ONLY for league fingerprints whose scoring-relevant fields (reception value, pass TD, INT, fumble-lost, bonus rules, K distance scoring, D/ST component scoring) are identical to that regime. Any other fingerprint is labelled DIAGNOSTIC_UNQUALIFIED; regimes are never pooled.
scoring.K_DST: K and D/ST are evaluated from COMPONENTS reconstructed under the exact league scoring (FG made by distance bin, FG missed, PAT; sacks, INT, fumble recoveries, defensive/return TD, safeties, blocked kicks, points allowed bins, yards allowed bins where the league scores them). Generic provider 'standard points' are the CONTROL, never the final model.

population.relevance_floor: B0p(HALF) >= 3.0 for QB/RB/WR/TE (as W2.P1); K: team has >= 1 FG attempt in prior 3 games; DST: all 32 teams
population.actual: stat-line points under the scoring; a player with no stat line scores 0 (DNP is an outcome, not an exclusion)
population.unknown_is_not_zero: a row with an unknown projection, identity or tactical field is EXCLUDED from the metric it cannot support and counted in coverage; it is never scored as 0 or as neutral certainty

baselines.B0p: PROXY source projection: mean fantasy points over the previous up to 4 games (strictly earlier, same season; prior-season tail for weeks 1-3). No stored history of the real source projections exists.
baselines.B1p: Wave 1 canonical-like champion: production evaluateInjuryModel applied to B0p with the historical designation (as W2.P1). The injury discount is applied exactly ONCE, by this layer; every challenger layer predicts a CONDITIONAL-ON-ACTIVE delta and receives availability only through the same call.
baselines.B2p: W2.P1 Role challenger C2 exactly as frozen in scripts/w2p1/FROZEN.json (the incumbent shadow Role candidate); required comparator for every game-plan layer ('does it add over Role?')
baselines.K_control: prior-4-game mean K points under exact scoring (generic projection control)
baselines.DST_control: prior-4-game mean D/ST points under exact scoring (generic projection control)
baselines.caveat: A proxy baseline knows less than the real source. Gains over B1p are an UPPER BOUND on gains over the real canonical forecast.

candidates.ridge_choice: lowest VAL MAE per position and scoring, ties -> larger lambda; the grid is fixed here and never extended
candidates.shrinkage: delta = confidence_weight * clamp(prediction, -cap, +cap); cap = max(1.0, 0.25 * B0p) (as W2.P1); confidence_weight from the declared evidence-sample table (HIGH 1.0 / MEDIUM 1.0 / LOW 0.6 / INSUFFICIENT 0)
candidates.layer_inclusion_rule: a layer is retained only if, on VAL, it improves MAE vs the previous step by >= 0.03 points with a 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound > 0 for that position; otherwise it is dropped for that position (reported REJECTED / NO_RELIABLE_SIGNAL) and later layers are evaluated without it. Exploratory feature discovery inside a layer happens on FIT only.
candidates.OFF: offensive game-plan scenario features: neutral-situation pass rate, pass-rate-over-expected, pace, play-action, motion, screen, RPO, no-huddle, early-down pass rate, red-zone/goal-line run rate, fourth-down aggressiveness, deep/short target mix, game-script sensitivity (all tier A); personnel/formation shares (tier B, carryover only for 2026)
candidates.DEF: defensive response features: blitz rate, pressure proxies, box counts, man/zone and shell (tier B carryover), explosive suppression, position-allowed rates after opponent adjustment, defensive injury absences, CONDITIONAL splits (e.g. vs heavy personnel) where cell n >= 30 plays else unconditional with a 'conditional not supported' flag
candidates.INT: player-vs-scheme interaction: player usage archetype fingerprint x opponent response of the matching archetype (WR slot/outside/vertical/underneath, RB gap/zone/receiving/screen, TE inline/slot, QB pocket/scramble/blitz-answer/play-action)
candidates.SECOND: second-order counters, FIXED hypothesis list declared here: (1) opponent blitz rate high -> RB/TE short-target share; (2) opponent two-high rate high -> underneath target share (slot/TE/RB); (3) heavy box -> play-action/vertical share; (4) WR1 absent -> WR2 route/target share and TE/RB redistribution. Any other counter discovered later is EXPLORATORY.
candidates.PROP: injury/personnel propagation graph features: teammate absences (WR1/WR2/TE/RB1/QB) and OL starter absences propagated to team pass volume, pressure/sack rate, RB checkdown share, opponent D/ST and K opportunity; the direct-backup-only rule is the CONTROL
candidates.continuity_weights: FIXED constants (not tuned): prior-season evidence weight = 0.5^(seasons_ago) x (HC same ? 1.0 : 0.4) x (OC same ? 1.0 : 0.6) x (QB same ? 1.0 : 0.6) where defensive evidence uses (HC, DC, front-seven continuity); evidence older than 2 seasons is not used. Sensitivity to these constants is EXPLORATORY only.

gates_forecast_G2.applies_to: each of QB, RB, WR, TE separately (and each retained layer) on FINAL, headline designations (NONE/QUESTIONABLE/DOUBTFUL), primary scoring HALF, vs champion B1p AND vs B2p
gates_forecast_G2.T1_coverage_and_n: covered rows >= 70% of eligible rows AND covered FINAL rows >= 250 (RB/WR/TE) or >= 100 (QB); otherwise INSUFFICIENT_FINAL_SAMPLE (never a pass)
gates_forecast_G2.T2_mae: delta_MAE(B1p - challenger) >= 0.05 points AND 95% cluster-bootstrap lower bound > 0 (clusters = team-week, B=2000, seed 20261014)
gates_forecast_G2.T2b_over_role: delta_MAE(B2p - challenger) >= 0.03 points with lower bound > 0 (the layer must add over Role)
gates_forecast_G2.T5_consistency: delta_MAE > 0 in at least 3 of the 5 FINAL weeks AND delta_MAE(VAL) > 0
gates_forecast_G2.T6_decisions: among decided disagreement pairs (|actual difference| >= 1 point): N >= 100 AND challenger wins >= champion wins AND one-sided binomial p < 0.10; fewer than 100 decided pairs => T6 INSUFFICIENT, which blocks SHADOW_QUALIFIED
gates_forecast_G2.T7_tiers: no tier with N >= 100 has delta_MAE < -0.10
gates_forecast_G2.T8_injury_and_cap: delta_MAE on QUESTIONABLE+DOUBTFUL rows >= -0.05; contribution on OUT rows exactly 0; MAX CAP-HIT RATE <= 10% (a cap-hit rate above 10% is a hard fail: the model is saturating the clamp, not forecasting)
gates_forecast_G2.T9_leakage: as-of assertions pass on every row; poison test byte-identical; ORACLE control beats every candidate by >= 25% of the champion MAE (harness sensitive)
gates_forecast_G2.T10_robustness: delta_MAE vs B1p > 0 under BOTH STD and PPR
gates_forecast_G2.multiplicity: Holm correction across the 4 positions for the lower-bound/p-value tests at family alpha 0.05; positions are reported independently and one position never rescues another

breakout.principle: empirical, out-of-time, position-specific, base-rate-relative. If a position shows no reliable discrimination the label is NO_RELIABLE_SIGNAL and no probability is emitted for that position.

SECONDARY_reported_only: residual breakout: actual - pregame expectation >= 1.5 x position residual SD estimated on FIT
relative: >= 2.0 x own baseline AND >= 15 points
labels_declared.rule: the PRIMARY definition is the only one used for gates and model choice; SECONDARY definitions may not be substituted after results are seen

breakout.population: relevance-floor rows (so negative examples are all players who met the same pregame bar and did NOT break out); base rates are computed within pregame tier

models.M1: L2-regularized logistic regression on the declared features, C grid [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10] chosen on VAL log loss
models.M2: calibrated gradient-boosted trees ONLY if M1 beats M0 on VAL AND position has >= 300 positive events in FIT+VAL; otherwise M2 is not fit
models.features: Role trend (snap/route/target/carry/red-zone share trends), teammate absence, depth promotion, rookie ramp, injury-return progression, matchup archetype fit, expected team scoring/pace/implied total, OL changes, GP-layer outputs; tier-B only as carryover

gates_B.B2_brier: Brier skill vs M0 (tier base rate) >= 2% relative with 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0
gates_B.B4_calibration: reliability slope in [0.8, 1.2] and expected calibration error <= 0.03 (10 equal-mass bins; bins with < 10 rows merged)
gates_B.B5_lift: top-decile lift >= 1.3 x base rate with N_events in top decile >= 10
gates_B.B6_negative_examples: report, for each driver, how often the same signal occurred WITHOUT a breakout (hit rate, not just conditional frequency among breakouts)
gates_B.fail: any failed gate => NO_RELIABLE_SIGNAL for that position; no probability, no 'Elevated' label

breakout.display_contract: banded labels only (Low / Typical / Elevated / High) with the historical base rate, the comparable-situation rate and its sample size; no decimal precision beyond whole percent

components: accuracy by distance bin (empirical-Bayes shrinkage to league)

inputs: own pressure/sack generation (tier A: sacks, FTN pass rushers/blitzers)

k_dst.gates: same T1-T10 form as G2 vs the generic-projection control, per position K and DST separately, with N >= 150 FINAL rows each (else INSUFFICIENT_FINAL_SAMPLE), plus spike-probability gates B1-B6. K and DST qualify independently of every other position.
k_dst.streaming: Streaming VOR is evaluated separately: does choosing the highest-forecast available K/DST each week beat last-week's-best (chasing) and the season-long hold, on FINAL

definitions.weekly_roster_vor: optimal EXPECTED legal lineup WITH the player minus WITHOUT the player (full lineup re-optimization, not slot-local), replacement drawn from bench, IR returners, then the VERIFIED pool with acquisition realism
definitions.ros_vor: sum over remaining usable weeks of weekly roster VOR with future byes, injury horizon and schedule
definitions.hold_vor: cost of losing the asset irrespective of this week's lineup status (bye does NOT zero it)
definitions.streaming_adjusted_vor: weekly VOR net of what the real market can recreate
definitions.scarcity_vor: value from the actual shape of the league position pool
definitions.league_vor: league-relative usefulness vs realistic league replacement
definitions.market_value_input: trade-market input from general scarcity; NEVER equated to private roster value

dynamic_vor.retrospective_roster_source: No point-in-time historical rosters/pools exist in the repo. Retrospective validation uses SEEDED SYNTHETIC rosters (seed 20261014): for each season 2025 and 2026-completed weeks, 12 teams built by a snake draft on prior-season fantasy rank with seeded noise, using EACH registered league's real roster/slot structure; waiver pool = all players not rostered with a documented availability rule. Real roster evaluation is PROSPECTIVE only (W2.P2 capture extension).
comparators: static positional VOR (nth_best_available frontier, the existing lib/weekly/replacement.ts)
metrics: Spearman(predicted weekly roster VOR, realized marginal lineup value with ACTUAL points)
calibration slope of predicted vs realized
decision regret = actual best legal option - recommended legal option
bad-drop rate for players on bye (future-bye-aware vs not)
week-to-week VOR volatility (rank stability) per component
scarcity VOR incremental signal over league VOR

gates_V.V1: roster-specific VOR has higher Spearman vs realized marginal lineup value than static positional VOR, with 95% bootstrap lower bound of the difference > 0, pooled over >= 400 roster-weeks
gates_V.V2: bench-aware replacement reduces mean decision regret vs no-bench
gates_V.V3: future-bye-aware hold reduces bad-drop rate vs bye-as-zero hold
gates_V.V4: a component is exposed in the SIMPLE view only if its week-to-week rank correlation >= 0.6 among players with unchanged role; otherwise deep view only
gates_V.bye_invariants: HARD: a bye sets current-week lineup contribution to 0 and NEVER sets Hold VOR or ROS VOR to 0 (property test over every position incl. K and D/ST)

missing_data_rules.rookies: no prior evidence -> confidence LOW, draft-capital prior only (rookie model = draft capital only), tactical layers neutral-with-flag
missing_data_rules.new_coach_or_coordinator: prior-season tactical evidence weight x0.4 (HC) / x0.6 (OC/DC); current-season evidence only after n >= 3 games, else flagged
missing_data_rules.traded_or_changed_team_player: team-dependent features reset to the new team; player-intrinsic usage retained with LOW confidence for 3 games
missing_data_rules.unknown_identity: excluded from model metrics, counted in coverage, never defaulted
missing_data_rules.limited_route_or_coverage_data: feature = NULL (unknown), layer contribution 0 WITH an explicit missing-evidence reason; never neutral certainty
missing_data_rules.stale_evidence: evidence older than 21 days at observation time is flagged STALE and confidence capped LOW
missing_data_rules.missing_projection: player stays in the market (verified available) with valuation UNKNOWN
missing_data_rules.missing_market_state: replacement falls back to the roster-only chain and is flagged REPLACEMENT_MARKET_UNVERIFIED; no verified-pool claim

rollback_criteria: any W2.R1 import appears under a production code path (source-scan test fails)
any production recommendation changes in the isolation diff (waiver/lineup/trade/start-sit surfaces byte-identical before/after)
the harness sensitivity control (ORACLE) fails to beat candidates
cap-hit rate > 10% on FINAL for a retained layer
a leakage assertion fails on any row
exploratory_only: feature discovery inside OFF/DEF/INT/SECOND/PROP on FIT
propagation-graph edge discovery beyond the declared list
any analysis on 2026 weeks 1-5 before a candidate is frozen (FINAL is not touched until freeze)

performance_budget.max_provider_requests_per_analysis: bounded by the existing certified market loader; no new provider fan-out
performance_budget.note: measured and reported, not tuned against correctness

freeze_protocol: after VAL choices, write scripts/w2r1/FROZEN.json (sha256 of this file, harness, driver, coefficients) BEFORE the first FINAL row is scored; FINAL is scored once; results are reported whatever they are
